business_problem: EF leverages the Salesforce platform to manage customers and drive business growth internationally. When expanding their business in mainland China, a critical market for EF, they also rely on this proven platform and its comprehensive capabilities. However, employees were experiencing latency and performance issues due to the service being deployed outside of mainland China.

Alibaba Cloud’s compliance capabilities, based on its security and data privacy strengths and expansive infrastructure, made meeting compliance requirements hassle-free for EF. Through Alibaba Cloud’s Quick Service, Quick Audience, and Quick BI tools, EF’s entire customer service system was streamlined and enhanced, from marketing activities to data analytics. EF can now deliver a seamless customer service experience across multiple channels.
evidence_quotes: EF leverages the Salesforce platform to manage customers and drive business growth internationally.
When expanding their business in mainland China, a critical market for EF, they also rely on this proven platform and its comprehensive capabilities.
However, employees were experiencing latency and performance issues due to the service being deployed outside of mainland China.
Mainland China’s unique regulatory requirements also added to EF’s compliance concerns.

EF’s call center needed an upgrade to support its high growth targets, and the lack of a China-based marketing platform made it difficult to roll out marketing campaigns efficiently — especially via local channels such as WeChat and SMS messages.
